entities.name: Telim'Tor
entities.description: Brutal military leader of Suq'Ata on Dominaria, fond of small artifacts.

entities.name: Husam'Tor
entities.description: Telim'Tor's brother, a man of strategy and cunning, killed in battle.

entities.name: Tor
entities.description: A wealthy and large clan to which Telim'Tor's family belongs.

entities.name: Suq'Ata
entities.description: Nation on Dominaria led militarily by Telim'Tor.

entities.name: Goblins
entities.description: Attackers of a royal caravan who looted priceless maps.

events.summary: Telim'Tor and his brothers join the Suq'Ata military; only Telim'Tor and Husam'Tor survive the second year.
events.quote: Only Telim'Tor and Husam'Tor survived the second year in the army.

events.summary: Goblins attack a royal caravan and loot priceless maps; Husam'Tor leads a strike force into the Ekundu Mountains and is killed.
events.quote: Husam'Tor led a strike force into the Ekundu Mountains to recover the maps but was killed in battle.

events.summary: Telim'Tor seizes control, recovers the maps but decimates the troops to one-tenth their number.
events.quote: Telim'Tor seized control, recovering the maps but decimating the troops to one-tenth their original number.

events.summary: In Amiqat Telim'Tor falsely blames Husam for the near disaster; the survivors are executed the next day and Telim'Tor becomes leader of the imperial army.
events.quote: he deceived the government by telling them that Husam had led them all to near disaster

relations.quote: Telim was angered by the fact that he always stood in Husam's shadow.
Telim'Tor (tel-lim-tor ) was the military leader of Suq'Ata on Dominaria .
Youngest of four sons born to the Tor, a wealthy and large clan
